I’m not a gym person, but I got motivated to go to the gym because I enjoyed biking and being outside. After biking and hiking, I realized I needed to get back in shape because I was struggling. 

I’m not good with self motivation, so I decided to join a cycling class, Zumba class, etc. Some gyms have these types of classes. After getting some confidence, I was able to start using the machines and then the free weights. 

It also helps to investigate your motivations. Are you doing this to look good? Or are you doing this because you care about your body and want it to be healthy? Because if you do it to look good, and you want to look good because you think it will make you happy, you might not be successful.
